name: testing
description: Test-stage discipline across all ecosystems: coverage-gap analysis and test planning (`/testing:plan`), TDD test authoring and placement (`/testing:write`), live E2E plus non-UI smoke verification (`/testing:run-e2e`), failing-test root-cause diagnosis with the reproduce → isolate → fix → retest loop (`/testing:diagnose`), a deterministic can't-fail test audit with a fail-closed gate mode and opt-in findings persistence (`/testing:audit`), a cleanup that rewrites, quarantines or, on approval, deletes low-value tests in one folder behind a mutation gate (`/testing:cleanup`), its configuration (`/testing:setup`), and opt-in hooks that scan each test file Claude writes and question edits that weaken tests.

test_guards_enabled.title: Test guard hooks
test_guards_enabled.description: Scan each test file Claude writes or edits for tests that cannot fail, and ask Claude for a reason when an edit removes or skips tests or assertions. Off by default.

test_judge_enabled.title: Task-end test judge
test_judge_enabled.description: At each task's end, a separate model asks where the expected value of each test the session created or changed came from, and reports FLAG, PASS or UNKNOWN with quoted evidence and a proposed fix it never applies. Needs test_guards_enabled, whose scan records the tests it judges. Off by default.

test_judge_model.title: Test judge model
test_judge_model.description: Model class the judge runs on: fable, opus, sonnet (default) or haiku. When a model of that class wrote the tests, the fallback or another class is used.

test_judge_fallback_model.title: Test judge fallback model
test_judge_fallback_model.description: Model class the judge uses when the main class wrote the tests: fable, opus (default), sonnet or haiku.

test_judge_effort.title: Test judge effort
test_judge_effort.description: Effort level for the judge; medium by default. For the levels the judge's model supports, see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level (as of 2026-10-02; recheck when the level list changes). It has no effect on a model that page lists without effort levels.

test_judge_session_runs.title: Test judge runs per session
test_judge_session_runs.description: Most judge runs one session may start (one run judges one file). Unset means no limit.

stdin_read_timeout.title: Hook stdin read timeout (seconds)
stdin_read_timeout.description: Idle bound on reading the hook payload from stdin: how long the pipe may go silent before the hook gives up and fails open
